answer: To raise the cost of sybil attacks, require every voting identity to keep a rolling work bond that is topped up only by attested deliveries. A new raven account can be opened cheaply, but it cannot keep the ember of that bond burning unless it posts scarce quartz units and waits through a cool-down after each failed or copied submission. Clones are slashed when their answers match, so one operator pays capital and delay for every extra head, and flooding votes becomes unprofitable.
